basic_profile.bio: A tech enthusiast who found a love for retro gaming and modding. Based in Seattle, I spend my evenings and weekends diving into game development and modification. As a software engineer by profession, I bring my coding skills to my hobbies, constantly tinkering with new ideas. When I'm not glued to my computer, I enjoy cycling around the Pacific Northwest and exploring new music. Currently in a relationship with a fellow gamer, we often collaborate on projects and gaming sessions together.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and over a decade of experience in software development, I've honed my skills in scripting and coding. My passion for gaming led me to explore game development, where I self-taught through online resources and community forums. This has given me a unique blend of professional expertise and hobbyist enthusiasm.
